cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Hide Inside the Callback
cards.instruction: Use an early harmless detail as the explanation for each new consequence, keeping your own role outside the pattern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That decorative ribbon started the tent collapse. I taught you to check what people hang on a support rope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You noticed the knot at least. The ribbon made that rope look like something we were meant to pull. Write 'misleading decoration' on the repair form.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you pulled it. Nobody else did.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because the ribbon marked it. Read back the warning I taught you to put on rigging: 'Do not pull.' Now put that on every ribbon before we raise the tent again.

reason: Make mentor correction drive the exact interpersonal tactic and make the final line something A needs B to do or hear. Preserve legitimate B questions and material evidence rather than writing a lesson-summary ending.
